verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a public API reference covering "anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI", including integrations, incidents and webhooks. Programmatic access uses token-based API keys that act like a user, with Owner permissions by default. An official CLI and webhooks round out programmatic control. Missing for 10: the probe found no published OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and the evidence has little detail on endpoint coverage or rate limits.
